title: Hire me
intro: I'm Karan Sharma, an indie software developer. Online I go by rootz491.
summary: I build web software directly: interfaces, APIs, and the deployment around them. If you need something made, write to me on Telegram and tell me what it is.
personal: Away from the screen I trek, play badminton, and watch films.

work.title: What I can take on
work.subtitle: Web products, the services behind them, and the setup required to run them.

items.title: Web applications
items.description: Sites and web apps with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, from an early version through to something you can run in production.

items.title: APIs and backends
items.description: APIs with NestJS or FastAPI, along with databases, caching, and search.

items.title: Deployment
items.description: Docker, continuous integration, and cloud hosting so a project can be shipped and kept running.

start.title: How to begin
steps: Message @rootz491 on Telegram with a short description, plus any links you already have.
We confirm the work fits and agree on the first piece before building starts.
I build it from Dehradun and send progress in writing.

engagement.title: Time and place
paragraphs: I work remotely from Dehradun. Afternoons and evenings here overlap with Europe. Mornings overlap with the Americas.
Write in English. A short note is enough: what you are building, what you need from me, and any timing that matters.

contacts.title: Where to reach me
contacts.subtitle: Telegram is the direct line. GitHub, the blog, and this site are there if you want to look around first.

elsewhere.intro: I also keep a few small tools online, including a pastebin and a request bin.
